description: Declares a custom event: `saved = output<Item>()`. Emit with `this.saved.emit(item)`; listen with `(saved)="..."`.
The object returned by `output()`: `emit()` and `subscribe()`. Not a signal, holds no value.
From `@angular/core/rxjs-interop`: exposes an observable as an output, subscribed only while the component lives.
Converts an output into an observable of its emissions.
Legacy `@Output()` implementation, an RxJS `Subject` subclass. Replaced by `output()`.
Receives data via inputs and reports intent via outputs, leaving state decisions to a container parent.
